<ic>That in order that the Conclave Liaison to the Senate is better able to serve the Empire:<br>
* The Liaison may have the power Advising the Senate, allowing them to attend and speak in Senate sessions, with the intention that this be used for Conclave related discussions<br>
* That the Liaison may address the Conclave once per summit without having to pay the initial mana cost.<br>
* That the post of Conclave Liaison to the Senate henceforth be renamed Imperial Magus.<br><br>''Proposed by Feroz, Seconded by Morrow''</ic>
===Overview===
* The abilities of the Conclave Liaison to the Senate were modified.
* The position was renamed [[Imperial Magus]]
* Passed in principle

===Date===
* Passed Autumn 378YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* The powers of the Conclave Liaison to the Senate were amended, and the name of the title changed.
